title: Ceviche-Style Cabbage Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry combining the freshness of ceviche with the crunch of cabbage.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until slightly wilted.
Add the diced tomatoes and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the ceviche seasoning, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce over the cabbage mixture and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until well combined.
Optional: garnish with additional cilantro or green onions for added flavor and color.
